classification_rule: Broad religious categories are demographic tools, not substitutes for traditions, denominations, schools, practices or theology.
integrity_rule: Every profile must distinguish historical reconstruction, community self-description, demographic estimate, interpretive comparison and project-symbolic material.
minor_tradition_rule: Smaller traditions are first-class records when they illuminate a distinct historical, textual, geographic, social or comparative structure. Do not merge them merely because their populations are small.
